column7: The OIDC code exchange ran on http.DefaultClient (x/oauth2 fallback, no client in the context), so a token_endpoint answering the POST with a 307 to another origin received the code, PKCE verifier and Basic client credentials. Fixed: CompleteSSO runs the exchange on SSOProvider.HTTPClient, set by buildSSOProviders to the discovery client (link-local dial guard, same-origin redirects), and refuses a provider without one. Found by V7-GAP-1 egress inventory (finding F2)
